description: Get directions between two points via SerpAPI. Provide a start point (one of start_addr, start_coords 'lat,lon', or start_data_id) and an end point (one of end_addr, end_coords, or end_data_id) — the data_ids come from google_maps_search results. Returns the route(s) with distance, duration and step-by-step legs. Shape the route with travel_mode (driving/transit/walking/…), avoid, and time. Result shape: { source, fetchedAt, query, search_metadata, search_parameters, places_info: [{ address, data_id, gps_coordinates }], durations: [{ travel_mode, duration, formatted_duration }], directions: [...] } — the list key is `directions`. Each direction: { travel_mode, via, distance (meters), duration (seconds), formatted_distance, formatted_duration, typical_duration_range, extensions, trips: [{ travel_mode, title, distance, duration, formatted_distance, formatted_duration, details: [{ title, action, distance, duration }] }] } plus, for transit, start_time, end_time, arrive_around, cost, currency; a Flight entry has only { travel_mode, icon, flight }.

end_addr.description: Ending address, e.g. 'Dallas, TX'. Provide one of end_addr/end_coords/end_data_id.

end_data_id.description: Place data id of the ending point (from a google_maps_search result).

no_cache.description: Force a fresh SerpAPI fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

route.description: Transit route option (travel_mode=3 only): 2=Fewer transfers, 3=Less walking, 4=Wheelchair accessible.

start_addr.description: Starting address, e.g. 'Austin, TX'. Provide one of start_addr/start_coords/start_data_id.

start_data_id.description: Place data id of the starting point (from a google_maps_search result).

zero_trace.description: Enterprise-only ZeroTrace mode: don't store search params/metadata on SerpAPI. Default false.

name: google_maps_directions
title: Get Google Maps Directions (SerpAPI)
